blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle with accurately capturing camera-object relations, especially for object orientation, camera viewpoint, and camera shots. This stems from the fact that existing MLLMs are trained on images with limited diverse camera-object relations and corresponding textual descriptions. To address this, we propose a synthetic generation pipeline to create large-scale 3D visual instruction datasets. Our framework takes 3D assets as input and uses rendering and diffusion-based image generation models to create photorealistic images preserving precise camera-object relations. Additionally, large language models (LLMs) are used to generate text prompts for guiding visual instruction tuning and controlling image generation. We create Ultimate3D, a large-scale 3D-grounded 2D visual instruction dataset. Ultimate3D consists of 240K VQAs with precise camera-object annotations, and corresponding benchmark. MLLMs fine-tuned on our proposed dataset outperform commercial models by a large margin, achieving an average accuracy improvement of 29.7% on camera-object relation recognition tasks. Our code, dataset, and benchmark will contribute to broad MLLM applications.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在准确捕捉相机-对象关系上挣扎着,特别是针对对象方向,相机视角,和相机镜头. 这是因为现有的MLLMs在图像上受到训练,相机-对象关系有限,文字描述相应. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出一个合成生成管道来创建大型的3D视觉指令数据集. 我们的框架以3D资产作为输入,并使用渲染和传播的图像生成模型来创建摄影现实主义的图像,保存精确的相机-对象关系. 此外,大型语言模型(LLMS)被用来生成文字提示,指导视觉指示调制和控制图像生成. 我们创建了Ultimate3D,一个大型的3D基底2D视觉指令数据集. Ultimate3D由240K VQA组成,带有精确的相机对象说明,以及相应的基准. MLLMs对我们提出的数据集进行了微调,大大超过了商业模型,使相机-对象关系识别任务的平均精度提高了29.7%。 我们的代码、数据集和基准将有助于广泛的MLLM应用。

However, research works have found needs and weaknesses of MLLMs Tong et al. (2024b) ; Fu et al. (2024) ; Yuksekgonul et al. (2022) . Tong et al. Tong et al. (2024b) point out the deficiency in visual representations learnt by ViT Dosovitskiy (2020) . In particular, two weakness categories (i.e., orientation/direction, viewpoint/perspective) focus on camera-object relations such as distinguishing simple concepts about object orientation (”right”, ”front”, ”back”, etc.), camera viewpoint location (”top”, ”bottom”, etc.), and camera-shot styles (”close-up”, ”long-shot”, etc.). As two examples in Fig. 1 show, current SOTA model (i.e., Gemini-3.5) struggle with understanding such camera-object relations.
The challenges to improving 3D-aware MLLM abilities on recognizing camera-object relations include: (1) capturing the complexity of the task, and (2) having a dataset containing millions of image-text pairs as is a common requirement for training MLLM on spatial perception tasks Cheng et al. (2024) ; Chen et al. (2024a) ; Guo et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh:
然而,研究发现MLLMs Tong等人(2024b),Fu等人(2024),Yuksekgonul等人(2022)的需要和弱点。 汤等. Tong等人(2024年b)指出,Vit Dosovitskiy(2020年)学到的视觉表现不足。 特别是,两个弱点类别(即方向/方向、观点/透视)侧重于相机-对象关系,例如区分物体方向的简单概念( " 右 " 、 " 前 " 、 " 后 " 等)、相机视角位置( " 顶 " 、 " 底 " 等)和相机拍摄风格( " 近距离 " 、 " 长镜头 " 等)。 作为图1中的两个例子,目前的SOTA模型(即双子座-3.5)在理解这种相机-对象关系方面挣扎.
提高3D-意识的MLLM识别相机-对象关系能力的挑战包括:(1) 掌握任务的复杂性,(2) 拥有包含数百万对图像文本的数据集,这是对MLLM进行空间感知任务培训的共同要求. Cheng等人(2024年);Chen等人(2024a年);Guo等人(2024年)。

blocks.en:
Nevertheless, to the best of our knowledge, none of the existing MLLMs or training datasets focus on the aforementioned camera-object relations. Prior methods for MLLM training data generation can be divided into the following two groups:
(1) Relabeling of existing real images . These works focus on generating textual captions by deep learning models given existing images Chen et al. (2024b) ; Li et al. (2024b) ; Zhang et al. (2024b) ; Sharifzadeh et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2023b) ; Du et al. (2023a) . Specifically, SpatialRGPT Cheng et al. (2024) and SpatialVLM Chen et al. (2024a) address spatial perception and reasoning weakness by providing a comprehensive data annotation pipeline leveraging multiple image segmentation, depth estimation, and camera calibration models to produce dense predictions for real images. But, in practice the accuracy of the predicted labels is not high and the dataset size and distribution is constrained by existing image datasets which predominantly only contain ”front” view objects.
(2) Generating synthetic images . Typically text-to-image DMs are utilized for synthetic image generation based on provided text prompts Liu et al. (2024c) ; Du et al. (2023b) ; Li et al. (2023b) . But, their score-based data curation is not robust to camera-object relations, or generation failures (See Appendix 10 ). Alternatively, simulation-based generation pipelines for visual reasoning Johnson et al. (2017) ; Liu et al. (2019) ; Greff et al. (2022) may provide ground truth camera-object relations, but the generated image quality, complexity, and diversity are still far from realistic. In summary, existing synthetic dataset generation pipelines fail to provide image-text pairs with ground truth camera-object relation, realistic image quality, and diverse image subject and context.
blocks.zh:
然而,据我们所知,现有的MLLM或培训数据集没有一个侧重于上述相机-物体的关系。 MILLM培训数据生成的先期方法可分为以下两类:
(1) 对现有真实图像重新加贴标签。 这些作品侧重于通过基于现有图像的深层学习模型生成文字标题 Chen等人(2024年b);Li等人(2024年b); 张等人(2024b);谢里夫扎德等人(2024); 张等(2023b); 杜等(2023a). 具体而言,空间GPT Cheng等人(2024年)和SpaceVLM 陈等. (2024a) 解决空间感知和推理弱点,提供综合数据注释管道,利用多种图像分割,深度估计,以及相机校准模型,为真实图像产生密集的预测. 但实际上,预测标签的准确性并不高,数据集的大小和分布受到现有图像数据集的限制,这些数据集主要只包含“前方”视图对象。
(2)生成合成图像. 通常使用文本对图像模型,根据所提供的文本提示Liu等人(2024c),Du等人(2023b),Li等人(2023b),合成图像生成。 但是,他们基于分数的数据校准对于相机-对象关系,或生成失败(见附录10 )并不健全. 或者,用于视觉推理的模拟生成管道Johnson等人(2017年);Liu等人(2019年);Greff等人(2022年)可能提供地面真实相机-对象关系,但生成的图像质量,复杂性和多样性仍然远非现实. 总之,现有的合成数据集生成管道未能提供具有地面真相机-对象关系的图像文本配对,真实的图像质量,以及多样的图像主题和上下文.

blocks.en: In this work, we propose a synthetic generation pipeline to create unlimited image-text pairs focusing on camera-object relations. With 3D assets (e.g., 3D models with texture, materials, and animation) as input, our framework utilizes a renderer (e.g., Blender) with arbitrary camera-object relation parameters to render a series of 3D ground truth priors (i.e., RGB, depth, segmentation). Those 3D priors are used as comprehensive conditions for stacked diffusion-based generation models (e.g., ControlNet) to generate photorealistic images preserving precise camera-object relations. Simultaneously, LLMs are used to generate versatile text prompts for the controlling of image context and object appearance, and to generate diverse VQA prompts regarding camera-object relations. With our framework, we have created the Ultimate3D dataset as a future benchmark for camera-object relations. The proposed framework serves as a data-generation pipeline that produces photorealistic image-text pairs with precisely controlled camera-object relations from 3D assets. We then use standard fine-tuning protocols to evaluate the effectiveness of Ultimate3D across multiple open-source MLLMs, including LLaVA-, Llama-, Gemma-, and Qwen-based models. Models fine-tuned on Ultimate3D outperform commercial MLLMs by a large margin (i.e., an average 29.7% accuracy improvement) on recognizing camera-object relations.
blocks.zh: 在这个作品中,我们提出一个合成的一代管道,以产生无限的图像文本对,专注于相机-对象关系. 以3D资产(例如有纹理,材料,动画的3D模型)作为输入,我们的框架使用一个具有任意相机-对象关系参数的渲染器(例如Blender)来制造一系列3D地面真理前传(即RGB,深度,分区). 这些3D前身被作为堆叠的基于扩散的生成模型(如ControlNet)的全面条件,以生成保存精确相机-对象关系的光现实化图像. 同时,LLMS被用于生成多功能文本提示,用于控制图像上下文和对象外观,并生成关于相机-对象关系的各种VQA提示. 在我们的框架下,我们创建了Ultimate3D数据集,作为照相机-对象关系的未来基准. 拟议的框架是一个数据生成管道,从3D资产中产生具有精确控制的相机-对象关系的光现实化图像文本对。 然后我们使用标准的微调协议来评价Ultimate3D在多个开源的MLLMs上的有效性,包括LLaVA-,Llama-,Gemma-,以及基于Quen的模型. 在Ultimate3D上对模型进行微调,在识别相机-对象关系上以大幅度(即平均29.7%的精度改进)超过商业MLLM.

blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Datasets and Benchmarks for MLLMs
blocks.zh: 2.1 小额供资和微型企业的数据集和基准

blocks.en: MLLMs use various dataset recipes for visual instruction tuning Dai et al. (2023) ; Li et al. (2023a) ; Liu et al. (2024b) ; Liu et al. (2024a) ; Li et al. (2024a) ; Chen et al. (2024c) ; Lin et al. (2024) ; Tong et al. (2024a) . Typically, dozens of datasets, focusing on different areas, are combined to enable the comprehensive abilities of MLLMs. Datasets include image captioning Lin et al. (2014) ; Young et al. (2014) ; Yu et al. (2016) , visual reasoning Hudson and Manning (2019) ; Liu et al. (2023) , general VQA data Gurari et al. (2018) ; Wang et al. (2023a) ; Liu et al. (2024b) on knowledge grounding Marino et al. (2019) ; Lu et al. (2022) , image understanding Goyal et al. (2017) , and OCR Mishra et al. (2019) ; Singh et al. (2019) . Further, most visual instruction datasets are relabeled or created from other existing image-based datasets (e.g., COCO Lin et al. (2014) , LAION Schuhmann et al. (2022) , LVIS Gupta et al. (2019) , Visual Genome Krishna et al. (2017) , ADE20K Zhou et al. (2019) ). As far as we know, none of the datasets focus on camera-object relations. Thus, the missing ground truth camera-object relation data exacerbates the task for deep learning models, such as SpatialRGPT Cheng et al. (2024) and SpatialVLM Chen et al. (2024a) . In fact, multiple papers have indicated MLLMs’ poor distinguishing ability on camera-object relations Tong et al. (2024b) ; Fu et al. (2024) . Our paper fills this gap by providing a generation pipeline, dataset, and benchmark.

blocks.en: In particular for the visual instruction data generation, LLMs, like GPT-4o OpenAI (2023) , have been successfully utilized in LLaVA Liu et al. (2024b) ; Liu et al. (2023) for dialogue text instruction generation, and used in MMVP Tong et al. (2024b) for answer grading. However, generating high-quality images corresponding to proposed text prompts has not been well developed. In this project, we leverage the diverse text generation capability of GPT-4o for the text prompt generation and we provide an image generation pipeline regarding 3D-awareness.
blocks.zh: 特别是对于视觉指令数据生成,LLMs,如GPT-4o OpenAI(2023),在LLaVA Liu等人(2024b)中被成功使用;LLMS等人(2023)用于对话文本指令生成,在MMVP Tong等人(2024b)中被使用作为回答分级. 然而,生成与拟议文本提示相对应的高质量图像的工作尚未取得良好进展。 在这个项目中,我们利用GPT-4o的各种文本生成能力迅速生成文本,我们提供了3D意识的图像生成管道。

blocks.en: 2.2 Simulation-based Image Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于模拟的图像生成

blocks.en: CLEVR Johnson et al. (2017) and Kubric Greff et al. (2022) use 3D engines to generate synthetic images by rendering 3D primitives at multiple arbitrary camera-object relations. Generally, simulation-based image rendering easily preserve ground truth camera-object relations in arbitrary viewpoint settings. However, the generated images are neither photorealistic nor diverse. Realism is limited by the assets’ level of detail and textures, and diversity is restricted by the small number of assets. These limitations constrain the usage of synthetic images in MLLM training to only object counting or simple spatial reasoning tasks Tong et al. (2024a) . In this project, we leverage the 3D geometry prior rendered by a 3D renderer to precisely guide the image generation pipeline for preserving ground truth camera-object relation.
blocks.zh: CLEVR Johnson等人(2017年)和Kubric Greff等人(2022年)使用3D引擎在多个任意相机-对象关系下通过渲染3D原始物生成合成图像. 一般来说,基于模拟的图像渲染在任意视角环境中很容易保存地面真理相机-对象关系. 然而,生成的图像既不具有光现实性,也不具有多样性。 现实主义受到资产细节和纹理水平的限制,多样性受到少数资产的限制. 这些限制限制了合成图像在MLLM训练中的使用,只能用于物体计数或简单的空间推理任务Tong等人(2024a). 在这个项目中,我们利用一个三维渲染器之前提供的3D几何来精确地引导图像生成管道来维护地面的真相机-对象关系.

blocks.en: 2.3 Generative Images
blocks.zh: 2.3 遗传图像

blocks.en:
Generative models provide advanced image generation by iteratively restoring the original data by denoising from Gaussian noise Ho et al. (2020) ; Song et al. (2020) ; Song et al. (2025) ; Song et al. (2024) ; He et al. (2023a) ; He et al. (2024) ; Song et al. (2023) ; Liao et al. (2025) ; Hua et al. (2025) ; Sun et al. (2025) ; Tang et al. (2025a) ; He and Aliaga (2024) ; Tang et al. (2025b) ; He and Aliaga (2023) ; He et al. (2023b) ; Yuan et al. (2025b) ; Yuan et al. (2025a) . Open-sourced Stable Diffusion Rombach et al. (2022) , and SDXL Podell et al. (2023) enable high-resolution and photo-realistic image generation and editing.
While generative models provide versatile context and subject, representative works (e.g., AURORA Krojer et al. (2024) , EditBench Wang et al. (2023b) , Prompt-to-Prompt Hertz et al. (2022) , and MagicBrush Zhang et al. (2024a) ) fail to control camera-object relations in the generated content, and quality guarantees rely on human checking.
ControlNet Zhang et al. (2023a) , built on versatile backbone DMs (e.g., SDXL), provides spatial control in the generated images by using various image priors (e.g., Canny edges, semantic segmentation, relative depth).

blocks.en: In particular, Ma et al. Ma et al. (2024a) explore using synthetic image generation for 3D pose estimation by conditioning diffusion models on pose angles. blocks.en: Visual Prior Rendering. Given an arbitrary camera-object relation β \beta , the system renders a corresponding set of geometrically aligned 2D visual priors I β I_{\beta} (Fig. 3 ) using a 3D renderer R R . We use a perspective camera with a default focal length of 35mm, while its extrinsic parameters are determined by β \beta . The asset remains upright and the camera is oriented toward its center. The rendered RGB images are further processed to provide Canny edges as additional visual priors.

blocks.en: Because all rendered modalities are produced from the same underlying 3D mesh and camera parameters, they are pixel-aligned and geometrically consistent with the specified camera-object relation β \beta . Images rendered under different values of β \beta therefore provide controlled variations in object orientation, camera viewpoint, and camera-shot distance while preserving exact 3D geometric supervision.

blocks.en: 4.1 Visual Instruction Generation
blocks.zh: 4.1 视觉教学生成

blocks.en: Data Source. Our framework uses open-sourced 3D assets datasets from ObjaverseXL Deitke et al. (2023) ; Deitke et al. (2024) and ShapeNet Chang et al. (2015) . Partial 3D assets are labeled following the synset list from ImageNet-1K Russakovsky et al. (2015) . We leverage this subset and define the asset category by its synset label. In particular, we manually select 100 synsets with explicit ”facing” orientation from the original list of ImageNet. In total, there are 1196 assets used for synthetic visual instruction generation.
blocks.zh: 数据来源. 我们的框架使用ObjaverseXL Deitke等人(2023年)、Deitke等人(2024年)和ShapeNet Chang等人(2015年)的开源3D资产数据集。 部分3D资产按照ImageNet-1K Russakovsky等人(2015年)的Synset列表标注. 我们利用这个子集,用它的合成标签来定义资产类别. 特别是,我们手动从ImageNet的原始列表中选择带有明确“faccing”方向的100个合成器。 共有1196项资产用于合成视觉教学。

blocks.en: ControlNets. We utilize SDXL-1.0 Podell et al. (2023) as the backbone of ControlNets. For selection of multiple visual priors, we found using both Canny edges and relative depth provides the best mix of camera-object relation preservation and image quality. The diffusion step T = 30 T=30 , and relative weights for depth and Canny edge ControlNets are 0.5 and 0.8, respectively. Several seconds are needed to generate an image by a single H100 GPU. Ablations and user studies are shown in Sec. 4.5 and Sec. 4.6 .
blocks.zh: 控制网. 我们利用SDXL-1.0 Podell等人(2023年)作为控制网的骨干。 为了选择多个视觉前科,我们发现既使用坎尼边缘,又使用相对深度,提供了相机-对象关系保存和图像质量的最佳组合. 扩散阶梯 T = 30 T = 30,深度和坎尼边缘控制网的相对权重分别为0.5和0.8. 需要几秒钟才能用一个H100 GPU生成一个图像. 第4.5节和第4.6节分别列出了校对和用户研究。

blocks.en: 4.2 Ultimate3D Dataset and Benchmark.
blocks.zh: 4.2 终极3D数据集和基准。

blocks.en: Our framework creates the Ultimate3D , a large-scale 3D-grounded 2D visual instruction dataset whose samples are generated from explicit 3D assets and controlled camera geometry, providing precise ground-truth camera-object relation annotations. Ultimate3D consists of 85K synthetic images and 18K cropped images of a single human per photograph and corresponding human orientation labels from MEBOW Wu et al. (2020) . For the synthetic images, we use 1180 3D assets covering 100 categories. For each 3D asset, there are 72 possible camera-object relations (8 orientations, 3 viewpoints, and 3 camera shot types) and we render a corresponding synthetic image for each relation. Then, each synthetic image is described by up to 3 textual QAs corresponding to object orientation, camera viewpoint, and camera-shot type, yielding a total of 240K corresponding QAs. Examples of synthetic images are in Appendix 15 . The images from MEBOW are useful because otherwise there is a strong lack of 3D assets of human which we find crucial to fine-tuning. The MEBOW images only have one QA corresponding to human orientation.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架创建了Ultimate3D,一个大型的3D基于2D的视觉指令数据集,其样本来自明确的3D资产和控制相机几何学,提供了精确的地面-真实相机-对象关系说明. Ultimate3D由85K合成图像和18K裁剪的每张照片单人图像以及来自MEBOW Wu等人(2020年)的相应人类定向标签组成. 对于合成图像,我们使用涵盖100类的1180个3D资产. 对于每个3D资产,可能有72个相机-对象关系(8个方向,3个角度,3个相机镜头类型),我们为每个关系制作相应的合成图像. 然后,每个合成图像由最多3个对应对象方向的文字QA,相机视角,和相机镜头类型来描述,共产生240K对应的QA. 合成图像的例子见附录15。 MEBOW的图像很有用,因为如果不这样的话,就严重缺乏我们发现对微调至关重要的人力三维资产。 MEBOW图像只具有一个与人类取向相对应的QA.

blocks.en: The Ultimate3D benchmark (Fig. 4 ) has two sets: (1) Synthetic Set. It contains 1200 synthetic images and 3600 QAs generated by our framework. Each image and QA has been manually reviewed to ensure correctness. This set covers all 100 categories with explicit facing orientation. The 3D assets utilized for benchmark generation do not overlap with those used for dataset generation. (2) Real Set. It contains two portions. The first portion is 2443 real images collected from Pascal3D+ Xiang et al. (2014) covering 10 categories (e.g. aeroplane, bicycle, etc.). Each image corresponds to a QA based on provided labels of object orientation or camera viewpoint. The second portion is 800 real images of humans collected from the MEBOW dataset Wu et al. (2020) . Each image corresponds to a QA on human orientation based on provided labels. In total, there are 3243 VQAs in the Real set. We resample the real images to keep a uniform distribution for each orientation and viewpoint type. Since no camera-shot information is provided in the real image set, the QAs in the real set exclude camera-shot type questions.
blocks.zh: Ultimate3D基准(图4)有两套:(1)合成集. 它包含了1200个合成图像和我们框架产生的3600个QA. 每个图像和质量保证都经过人工审查,以确保正确。 这一组包括所有100个类别,明确了面对方向。 用于基准生成的三维资产与用于数据集生成的资产并不重叠。 (2) 真实设定。 它包含两个部分。 第一部分是从Pascal3D+收集的2443幅真实图像 Xiang等人(2014年)涵盖10类(如飞机,自行车等). 每个图像都对应基于所提供的对象方向或相机视角标签的QA. 第二部分是从MEBOW数据集Wu等人(2020年)采集的800幅真实的人类影像. 每个图像对应基于所提供的标签的人类导向的QA. 共有3243个VQA在Real集. 我们重新绘制真实的图像,以保持每个方向和视角类型的统一分布。 由于真实图像集中没有提供相机拍摄信息,所以真实集中的QA排除了相机拍摄类型的问题.

blocks.en: Both the Ultimate3D dataset and the benchmark have no camera-object relation bias, which is very uncommon in the real image datasets (e.g. most images capture objects facing straight to the camera Xiang et al. (2014) ). In contrast, in our dataset the number of images in each orientation, viewpoint, and camera-shot type are evenly distributed.
blocks.zh: Ultimate3D数据集和基准都没有相机-对象关系偏差,这在真实的图像数据集中非常罕见(例如大多数图像捕捉正对着相机Xiang等人的物体(2014)). 相比之下,在我们的数据组中,每个方向、视角和摄影机类型的图像数量均匀分布。

blocks.en: 4.3 Advancing 3D-Aware MLLMs
blocks.zh: 4.3 推进三维软件MLLM

blocks.en: We explore how much our synthetic Ultimate3D dataset can improve the MLLMs recognition capability on camera-object relation. The evaluation results on both synthetic and real image VQA benchmarks indicate the fine-tuned baseline models are significantly improved from random guess and outperform commercial SOTAs.
blocks.zh: 我们探索我们合成的Ultimate3D数据集可以提高MLLMs在相机-对象关系上的识别能力多少. 合成和真实图像VQA基准的评价结果表明,通过随机猜测和超过商业SOTA,微调基准模型得到了显著改进。

blocks.en: Training Details. We fine-tune and evaluate several recent open-source MLLM families, including LLaVA-1.5/1.6 Liu et al. (2024a) , Llama-3.2-Vision-11B Meta (2024) , Gemma-4 models Google DeepMind (2026b) , and Qwen-based models Bai et al. (2025) ; Yang et al. (2025) . All models are fine-tuned for one epoch on the Ultimate3D training set. To evaluate the effect of training on Ultimate3D, we compare each base model with its corresponding fine-tuned version. We adopt two fine-tuning protocols depending on the model family. For LLaVA and Llama-3.2-Vision, we follow their official full fine-tuning recipes Liu et al. (2024a) ; Meta (2024) , updating the MLP vision-language connector and the LLM decoder while freezing the vision encoder. For LLaVA, we use BF16 precision, a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , cosine scheduling with a warm-up ratio of 0.03, zero weight decay, and gradient checkpointing. For Llama-3.2-Vision-11B, we use BF16 precision, fused AdamW, a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , a per-device batch size of 2 with gradient accumulation of 4, and gradient clipping at 1.0. For Gemma-4 and Qwen-based models, we use parameter-efficient fine-tuning primarily based on LoRA. For the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3-VL series, we use Unsloth-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning with a hybrid trainable-parameter policy: the vision encoder is kept frozen, the language-model attention and MLP projections are adapted with LoRA (rank 16, α \alpha =16, dropout 0, no bias terms, no RSLoRA), and the vision–language connector (merger) is optimized as full weights. For Gemma-4 models, we use plain LoRA with rank 16, α = 32 \alpha=32 , and dropout 0.05, applied to compatible linear layers in the language model and vision embedding projection. Gemma-4 models are trained in BF16 using fused AdamW, an effective batch size of 4, and a constant learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} without warmup or weight decay. For Gemma-4-31B, we resumed from the best intermediate checkpoint with a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , cosine decay, and weight decay of 0.01 due to late-stage instability. Training takes approximately 12 hours on 4 H100 GPUs for LLaVA and Llama-3.2-Vision, up to 2.5 days on a single H100 GPU for Gemma-4, and up to 8 days on a single RTX 6000 GPU for Qwen-based models.

Gemma-4型号在BF16中使用引信AdamW进行训练,有效批量尺寸为4,恒定学习速率为1×10−4 1\times 10×4}没有热身或重量衰减. 对Gemma-4-31B来说,我们从最好的中间检查站恢复了学习,学习率为3×10−5 3\times 10×5},余弦衰减,由于晚期不稳定,体重衰减为0.01。 对LLaVA和Llama-3.2-Vision的4个H100GPU的培训大约需要12小时,对Gemma-4的1个H100GPU的培训最多需要2.5天,对Quen型的1个RTX 600GPU的培训最多需要8天。

blocks.en: Evaluation Settings. We evaluate the baseline MLLMs and their fine-tuned versions on Ultimate3D benchmark and MMVP benchmark Tong et al. (2024b) . MMVP benchmark is an intentionally selected real image dataset which is claimed to be difficultly distinguished by MLLMs. We manually label 89 VQAs regarding camera-object relations. During evaluation, MLLMs’ textual responses are evaluated by GPT-4o, which is prompted to judge if the responses correspond to the ground truth answers. We calculate the accuracy rate ( % \% ) of the MLLMs responses as the evaluation metric. We also include commercial SOTA models (e.g. GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet) in the evaluation.
blocks.zh: 评价设置. 我们根据Ultimate3D基准和MMVP基准Tong等人(2024年b)评估基线的MLLMs及其微调版本。 MMVP基准是一种有意选择的真实图像数据集,据称MLLMs难以区分。 我们手动标注89 VQA 有关相机-对象关系。 在评价期间,MLLMs的文字反应由GPT-4o来评价,这促使GPT-4o来判断这些反应是否与基本真理答案相符. 我们计算MLLM响应的精确率(% Q)作为评价的衡量标准. 我们还将商用SOTA模型(如GPT-4o和Claude-3.5-Sonnet)纳入评价.

blocks.en: Quantitative Results. The quantitative results of response accuracy ( % \% ) are shown in Tab. 1 . We assess the effect of training on Ultimate3D through base-to-fine-tuned comparisons within each model family. Overall, we observe a consistent trend: off-the-shelf MLLMs struggle with camera-object relation recognition, whereas task-specific fine-tuning on Ultimate3D substantially improves performance across multiple model families. This difficulty appears even for strong general-purpose vision-language models, including LLaVA, Llama-3.2-Vision, Gemma-4, Qwen-based models, and closed commercial MLLMs. Several baseline models tend to collapse to a small set of frequent answers, such as predicting “front” orientation or “top” viewpoint regardless of the actual image content. As a result, their accuracies are often close to random-guess levels, e.g., 33.3 % 33.3\% for three-way viewpoint recognition and 12.5 % 12.5\% for eight-way orientation recognition. This weakness may be related to biases in commonly used visual instruction datasets, where most images are captured from canonical front-facing directions and from common side or above viewpoints. The poor off-the-shelf performance across both older and more recent MLLM families suggests that camera-object relation understanding remains underrepresented in existing MLLM training data.
blocks.zh: 量化结果。 响应精度的定量结果(% \%)在Tab中显示. 1. 我们通过每个模范家庭内部的基础与精细比较,评估培训对Ultimate3D的影响。 总体而言,我们观察到一个一致的趋势:现成的MLLMs与相机-对象关系识别发生斗争,而针对Ultimate3D的任务的微调大大改善了多个模范家庭的性能。 这种困难甚至出现在强大的通用视觉语言模型上,包括LLaVA,Llama-3.2-Vision,Gemma-4,Quen基模型,以及封闭的商业MLLMs. 一些基线模型往往会崩溃为少数常见的答案,例如,无论实际图像内容如何,预测“前方”方向或“上方”观点。 因此,他们的敏锐度往往接近随机水平,例如,33.3%的三向观点识别和12.5 %的八向定向识别。 这一弱点可能与常用的视觉指示数据集的偏差有关,其中大多数图像是从犬形前视向方向和共同侧面或以上角度获取的. 较老和较晚的MLLM家庭的现成成绩不佳,这表明,在现有的MLLM培训数据中,相机-对象关系理解仍然不足。

blocks.en: Fine-tuning on our synthetic Ultimate3D dataset substantially improves camera-object relation recognition across all evaluated open-source model families. On the Ultimate3D benchmark, fine-tuned LLaVA models significantly outperform their corresponding base models across object orientation, camera viewpoint, and camera-shot recognition. For example, fine-tuned LLaVA-1.6-13B improves orientation accuracy from 16.1 % 16.1\% to 72.4 % 72.4\% , viewpoint accuracy from 30.7 % 30.7\% to 72.3 % 72.3\% , and camera-shot accuracy from 42.3 % 42.3\% to 94.8 % 94.8\% . The smaller LLaVA-1.6-7B model achieves similarly competitive performance, reaching 71.5 % 71.5\% , 71.3 % 71.3\% , and 94.1 % 94.1\% on these three tasks, respectively. This suggests that the ability to distinguish camera-object relations does not necessarily require a very large backbone, but instead benefits strongly from task-specific supervision.
blocks.zh: 对合成的Ultimate3D数据集进行精细调整,大大改善了所有被评价的开源模型家族的相机-对象关系识别. 在Ultimate3D基准上,微调的LLaVA模型在对象定向,相机视角,和相机镜头识别上显著超过它们相应的基础模型. 例如,微调的LLaVA-1.6-13B提高了定向精度,从16.1% 16.1\%提高到72.4% 72.4\%,视角精度从30.7% 30.7\%提高到72.3\%,镜头精度从42.3% 42.3\%提高到94.8\%。 较小的LLaVA-1.6-7B模型取得了类似的竞争性性能,分别达到71.5% 711.5\%,71.3% 71.3\%,94.1% 94.1% 94.1% 以上。 这表明区分相机-对象关系的能力并不一定需要非常大的骨干,而是从特定任务的监督中大有裨益.

blocks.en: The same conclusion holds for Llama-3.2-Vision, Gemma-4, and Qwen-based models. Llama-3.2-Vision-11B obtains the largest average improvement among the models in Tab. 1 , with an average gain of 60.46 60.46 percentage points across the three camera-object relation tasks. The original released model often refuses to answer some recognition questions, e.g., responding that it cannot provide information about the individual in the image, while the fine-tuned model produces valid relation predictions and achieves the best orientation accuracy in Tab. 1 . These results indicate that Ultimate3D supervision can correct both answer-format failures and visual relation recognition failures.
blocks.zh: 同一结论也适用于Llama-3.2-Vision、Gemma-4和基于Quen的模型。 Llama-3.2-Vision-11B在Tab中获得了模型中最大的平均改进. 1,三个相机对象关系任务平均增益60.46 60.46个百分点. 最初发布的模型经常拒绝回答一些识别问题,例如,回应称无法在图像中提供个人信息,而微调的模型则产生有效的关系预测,并在Tab中实现最佳定向精度. 1,这些结果显示,Ultimate3D监督可以同时纠正答案格式故障和视觉关系识别故障.

blocks.en: Recent Gemma-4 and Qwen-based models further confirm that the benefit of Ultimate3D supervision is not specific to the LLaVA architecture. Before task-specific fine-tuning, Gemma-4 models achieve only 36.0 36.0 – 51.1 % 51.1\% overall accuracy when averaging all reported relation-recognition columns. After LoRA fine-tuning, they reach 69.4 69.4 – 71.3 % 71.3\% overall accuracy, corresponding to an average improvement of 26.3 26.3 percentage points. The improvements are consistent across all three relation types, with average gains of 20.0 20.0 – 37.5 37.5 percentage points on object-direction recognition, 9.2 9.2 – 26.7 26.7 percentage points on viewpoint recognition, and 38.0 38.0 – 49.1 49.1 percentage points on camera-shot recognition.
blocks.zh: 最近的Gemma-4和Quen基模型进一步证实,Ultimate3D监督的好处并不是LLaVA架构所特有的. 在针对特定任务的微调之前,Gemma-4模型在平均所有报告的关系识别列时,只达到36.0 36.0 — — 51.1% 51.1 — — 总的精确度。 在LORA微调后,它们达到了69.4 69.4 – 71.3% 71.3\%总精度,相当于平均提高26.3 26.3个百分点. 所有三种关系类型的改进是一致的,对象方向识别的平均收益为20.0 20.0 - 37.5 37.5个百分点,观点识别为9.29.2 - 26.7 26.7个百分点,镜头拍摄识别为38.0 38.0 - 49.1 49.1个百分点。

blocks.en: Qwen-based models show a similar pattern. Their base versions achieve 37.3 37.3 – 48.9 % 48.9\% overall accuracy, while the fine-tuned versions reach 69.5 69.5 – 75.7 % 75.7\% overall accuracy, improving by 30.5 30.5 percentage points on average. In particular, fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-32B achieves the strongest overall performance among the evaluated open models in Tab. 1 , reaching 75.7 % 75.7\% average accuracy across all reported columns. It also obtains strong performance on both synthetic and real subsets, suggesting that the learned camera-object relation knowledge is not restricted to rendered synthetic images.
blocks.zh: 以文为基础的模型显示出类似的模式. 其基础版本达到37.3 37.3 — 48.9% 48.9 % 总体准确度,而微调版本达到69.5 69.5 — 75.7 % 75.7 % 总体准确度,平均提高30.5 30.5个百分点. 特别是微调的Qwen3-VL-32B在Tab中实现了被评价的开放模型中最强的整体性能. 1,所有报告栏平均准确度达到75.7% 75.7%. 它还在合成和真实子集上获得强效性能,说明所学的相机-对象关系知识并不限于制成合成图像.

blocks.en: Among closed commercial MLLMs, newer models generally perform better than earlier GPT-4o- and Claude-3-era models on some orientation and viewpoint columns, but the improvement is not uniform across tasks. For example, Gemini-3.5-Flash with the high thinking setting achieves stronger orientation accuracy than its minimal-thinking counterpart, improving from 56.8 % 56.8\% to 65.3 % 65.3\% on the Ultimate3D orientation column. However, increasing the thinking budget does not consistently improve all relation types: its camera-shot accuracy decreases from 37.1 % 37.1\% to 33.8 % 33.8\% . This suggests that additional reasoning budget can help in some spatial-relation cases, but it does not resolve the lack of grounded camera-object relation understanding.
blocks.zh: 在封闭的商业MLLMs中,较早期的GPT-4-和Claude-3-时代的模型在一些方向和视角栏上一般表现优异,但不同任务间的改进并不一致. 例如,具有高思维环境的双子座-3.5-闪电比其最小思维对等器的定向精度更强,在Ultimate3D定向栏上从56.8% 56.8\%提高到65.3\%. 然而,增加思维预算并没有持续改善所有关系类型:照相机拍摄精度从37.1%37.1%下降到33.8%33.8 %。 这表明,在一些空间关系案件中,额外的推理预算可以有所帮助,但并不能解决缺乏对摄像机-对象关系的了解的问题。

blocks.en: Compared with closed commercial MLLMs, our fine-tuned open models achieve especially strong performance on the Ultimate3D relation-recognition tasks. Although recent commercial models improve over earlier commercial baselines on some orientation and viewpoint columns, they remain substantially weaker on several Ultimate3D tasks, especially camera-shot recognition, where fine-tuned open models consistently reach around 90 % 90\% accuracy or higher. Overall, these results demonstrate that Ultimate3D provides effective supervision for camera-object relation understanding, improves both synthetic and real-image evaluation performance, and generalizes across multiple MLLM families, including LLaVA, Llama, Gemma, and Qwen.
blocks.zh: 与封闭的商业MLLMs相比,我们微调的开放模型在Ultimate3D关系识别任务上取得了特别强的性能. 虽然最近的商业模型在某些方向和视角栏上比早先的商业基线有所改善,但在几个Ultimate3D任务上,特别是在镜头识别上,它们仍然大大弱化,因为经过微调的开放模型的准确度一直达到90%或更高。 总体而言,这些结果显示,Ultimate3D为了解相机-对象关系提供了有效的监督,提高了合成和真实图像的评价性能,并概括了包括LLaVA,Llama,Gemma,和Quen在内的多个MLLM家族.

blocks.en: Qualitative Results.
blocks.zh: 定性结果.

blocks.en: We show qualitative comparisons in Fig. 4 . Commercial SOTA models (e.g. Gemini-3.5-Flash) and open-source models (e.g. Gemma-4-31B-it) struggle with precise recognition of all three types of camera-object relations. For the two commercial models, their object-orientation predictions are often unreliable despite producing plausible natural-language explanations. We also observe systematic biases in viewpoint and camera-shot recognition: both commercial models tend to underestimate viewpoint angle, e.g., mistaking top views as horizontal, and overestimate camera-shot distance, e.g., mistaking medium-shot images as long-shot. The original Gemma-4-31B-it model also shows strong response biases across all types of questions. Its orientation predictions are biased mostly toward “Left” and “Right”, its viewpoint predictions are dominated by “Horizontal”, and its camera-shot predictions are biased toward “Long-shot”. In comparison, the Gemma-4-31B-it model fine-tuned on our Ultimate3D dataset provides more plausible predictions across all three tasks on both the synthetic and real subsets of our benchmark. Additional comparisons are provided in Supplemental Sec. 14 .
blocks.zh: 我们在Fig中显示质量比较。 4,商业SOTA模型(如双子座-3.5-Flash)和开源模型(如Gemma-4-31B-it)在精确识别所有三种相机-对象关系上挣扎. 对两种商业模型来说,它们的目标导向预测往往不可靠,尽管提出了可信的自然语言解释。 我们还观察到观点和相机拍摄识别的系统性偏差:两种商业模型都倾向于低估视角角度,例如,将顶端观点误认为水平,以及高估相机拍摄距离,例如,将中镜头图像误认为长镜头. 最初的Gemma-4-31B-it模式也显示在所有类型问题中都有强烈的响应偏差. 其定向预测大多偏重于“左”和“右”,其观点预测以“Horizontal”为主,其摄影预测偏重于“长镜头”。 相比之下,Gemma-4-31B-it模型对我们的Ultimate3D数据集进行了微调,就我们基准的合成子集和实际子集的所有三项任务提供了更可信的预测。 补充第14节提供了其他比较。

blocks.en: We hypothesize that these behavioral biases arise from dataset bias and the lack of camera-object visual instruction data in current MLLM training pipelines. Without modifying the model architecture or training scheme, our fine-tuned Gemma-4-31B-it model substantially improves camera-object relation recognition and outperforms strong commercial models on several Ultimate3D tasks, despite relying only on task-specific supervision. This indicates that the lack of targeted camera-object relation data is a major factor behind current MLLMs’ weakness on camera-object relation recognition.
blocks.zh: 我们假设这些行为偏差产生于数据集偏差和当前MLLM训练管道中缺乏相机-对象视觉指示数据. 我们微调的Gemma-4-31B-it模型在不修改模型架构或培训计划的情况下,大大改进了相机-对象关系识别,并在几个Ultimate3D任务上超越了强大的商业模型,尽管只依靠任务特定监督. 这表明缺乏目标相机-对象关系数据是目前MLLMs在相机-对象关系识别方面的弱点的一个主要因素。

blocks.en: Limitations. The numerical prediction of camera-object relation β \beta is more challenging for MLLMs compared to the categorical prediction we report. Preliminary tests show MLLMs can handle numerical prediction of camera-object relation for a single category, but struggle with a hundred categories as in our dataset. Since our main contribution is the discovery of the dataset bottleneck and the generation pipeline, we leave addressing this limitation as future work.
blocks.zh: 限制。 相机-对象关系β\β的数值预测对MLLMs来说比我们报告的绝对预测更具挑战性. 初步测试显示 MLLMs 能够处理一个单一类的相机-对象关系的数字预测,但和我们数据集中的100个类一样挣扎. 由于我们的主要贡献是发现数据集瓶颈和生成管道,我们把解决这一局限性作为今后的工作。

blocks.en: 4.4 Generalization of Ultimate3D to General VQA
blocks.zh: 4.4 将终极3D普遍化为普通VQA

blocks.en: To explore the generalization of 3D camera-object relation capturing with general VQA tasks, we fine-tune LLaVA-1.6-13B models by a half-half mixture of Ultimate3D (240K VQAs) and randomly sampled 240K VQAs from LLaVA-Instruct-665K Liu et al. (2024a) . Tab. 2 presents the dataset mixture finetuning performance on VQAv2 Goyal et al. (2017) , our Ultimate3D , and MMVP benchmarks. The results demonstrate that incorporating Ultimate3D significantly enhances camera-object relation reasoning while maintaining general VQA performance.
blocks.zh: 为了探索3D相机-对象关系与一般VQA任务捕获的泛化,我们用Ultimate3D(240K VQAs)的半种混合物对LLaVA-Instruct-665K模型进行微调,随机抽取了240K VQAs. 刘等 (2024a). Tab. 2介绍了关于VQAv2 Goyal等人(2017年)、我们的Ultimate3D和MMVP基准的数据集混合物微调性能。 结果显示,加入Ultimate3D可显著增强相机-对象关系推理,同时保持一般的VQA性能.

blocks.en: Table 2: Generalization. We finetune LLaVA-1.6-13B model using a mixture of both general VQA and camera-object relation VQA datasets. Without degradation on general VQA tasks, finetuned model improves its ability on camera-object relation recognition and beats SOTA (i.e. GPT-4o) by 28.42% accuracy on Ultimate3D benchmark. ∗ * denotes the average accuracy ( % \% ) across all 3 types of camera-object relation VQAs in Tab. 1 .
blocks.zh: 表2:概论。 我们利用一般VQA和相机-对象关系VQA数据集的混合物,微调LLaVA-1.6-13B模型. 不在一般的VQA任务上降解,微调的模型提高了其在相机-对象关系识别上的能力,并在Ultimate3D基准上将SOTA(即GPT-4o)的精度提高28.42%. **表示Tab中所有3类相机-对象关系VQA的平均精度(%\%). 1 (英语).

blocks.en: Figure 5: Ablations on Image Generation Pipeline. Our framework shows superior performance by using multi-ControlNet with SDXL backbones, and introducing both Canny edges and depth maps as visual priors. It consistently delivers better robustness and quality compared to text-only SDXL and Ma et al. (2024a) . When these visual priors are removed (top-right: removing all visual priors; bottom-right: removing depth prior), the generator often fails to produce good results and brings lower generation success rate (see Sec 4.6 , Ma et al. (2024a) only achieves 55.11 % 55.11\% success rate v.s. ours 93.07 % 93.07\% )
blocks.zh: 图5:图像生成管道上的缺陷. 我们的框架通过使用带有SDXL主干线的多控制网,以及引入Canny边缘和深度地图作为视觉前传,来显示优异的性能. 与只使用文本的SDXL和Ma等人(2024a)相比,它始终提供更好的强性和质量。 当这些视觉前科被删除(右上方:删除所有视觉前科;右下方:删除深度之前)时,生成器往往不能产生良好结果,并带来更低的生成成功率(见Sec 4.6, Ma等人(2024a)),只实现55.11%,55.11\%成功率对我们的93.07%,93.07\%).

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablations on Image Generation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4.5 图像生成管道的故障

blocks.en: In Fig. 5 , we ablate our image generation pipeline and illustrate better quality than Ma et al. (2024a) by: (1) removing the visual priors; and (2) using alternative image generation backbones; (3) changing the group of visual priors given to the image generator. Compared to text-only SDXL and Ma et al. (2024a) , we find that multiple visual priors may significantly improve the robustness of image generation under complex camera-object relation (especially for viewpoints of the object’s back-side, and for 3D assets with low level-of-detail). In particular, the depth and Canny edge prior are crucial. However, we find that adding more priors (e.g., RGB, semantic masks, normal maps) does not explicitly improve quality. Moreover, our SDXL backbone outperforms other alternatives (i.e. SD-V1.5 Rombach et al. (2022) ). Discussions in Appendices 11 and 12 .
blocks.zh: 在图5中,我们通过:(1)去掉视觉前科;(2)使用替代图像生成主干线;(3)改变给图像生成器的视觉前科组别,从而降低我们的图像生成管道,并表现出比马等人(2024a)更好的质量. 与仅文本的SDXL和Ma等人(2024a)相比,我们发现多种视觉前传可能显著改善复杂相机-对象关系下图像生成的稳健性(特别是对于对象后侧的视角,以及对于细节水平低的3D资产). 特别是,前面的深度和坎尼边缘至关重要。 然而,我们发现,增加更多的前科(如RGB,语义口罩,普通地图)并没有明显提高质量. 此外,我们的SDXL骨干比其他替代品(即SD-V1.5 Rombach等人(2022年))。 附录11和12的讨论

blocks.en: 4.6 User Study on Dataset Quality
blocks.zh: 4.6 数据集质量用户研究.

blocks.en: We investigate using text-image aligning metric and pose-estimation model prediction to evaluate quality of our Ultimate3D dataset but find those metrics to be deficient (Appendix 10 ). Instead, we perform a comprehensive user study as a quality check of Ultimate3D dataset. As Appendix 13 shows, the user will see two images side-by-side (Fig. 9 ): an RGB image rendered by Blender (representing I β I_{\beta} ), and a synthetic image generated by our method using I β I_{\beta} . Preserving the RGB image’s 3D geometry and structure in the synthetic image is regarded as success. Our study includes 225 randomly sampled image pairs where each image is independently reviewed by 3 users. Overall success rate is 93.07 % \% (agreement rate among 3 users is 94.4%). In comparison, we perform another similar-objective user study on Ma et al. (2024a) . The overall success of this alternative method was only 55.11% (we explain the cause of this reduced performance in Sec. 4.5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们利用文本图像对齐度量和姿势估计模型预测来调查,以评估我们Ultimate3D数据集的质量,但发现这些度量不足(附录10)。 相反,我们进行了全面的用户研究,作为Ultimate3D数据集的质量检查. 如附录13所示,用户将看到两个侧面图像(图9):由Blender(代表Iβ I_{\beta})渲染的RGB图像,以及我们使用Iβ I_{\beta}生成的合成图像。 在合成图像中保留RGB图像的3D几何和结构被认为是成功的. 我们的研究包括225个随机抽样的图像对,每个图像都由3个用户独立审查. 总体成功率为93.07%(3个用户的协议率为94.4%)。 相比之下,我们对Ma等人(2024a)进行了另一项类似的用户研究。 这种替代方法的总体成功率只有55.11%(我们在4.5号文件中解释了业绩下降的原因)。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we discover the dataset bottleneck of MLLMs for distinguishing camera-object relations. Given only 3D assets, our framework is able to generate unlimited image-text pairs of diverse camera-object relations with no distribution bias. We also provided Ultimate3D dataset and benchmark MLLM community. Moreover, fine-tuned open-sourced MLLMs using our dataset outperform SOTA commercial models by a significant margin. We plan to extend our framework for multi-object image generation with additional viewpoints, and improve numerical prediction capability on camera-object relation.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们发现了MLLMs用于区分相机-对象关系的数据集瓶颈. 由于只有3D资产,我们的框架能够产生无限的图像文本对,各种相机-对象关系没有分布偏差. 我们还提供了Ultimate3D数据集和MLLM社区基准。 此外,利用我们的数据集对开源的MLLMs进行微调,大大超过了SOTA的商业模型。 我们计划扩大多对象图像生成框架,增加视角,提高相机-对象关系的数值预测能力。

blocks.en: ⬇ SYSTEM_PROMPT_FOR_VQA_GEN = " You are an AI visual assistant , and you are seeing a single image . What you see are provided with several sentences , describing the same image you are looking at . Answer all questions as you are seeing the image . Design a conversation between you and a person asking about this photo . The answers should be in a tone that a visual AI assistant is seeing the image and answering the question . Ask diverse questions and give corresponding answers . Include questions asking about the visual content of the image , including the object orientation and its corresponding azimuth degree , the camera viewpoint of the image and corresponding camera elevation angle , the camera shot type of the image and the distance from camera to the target object . Only include questions that have definite answers : (1) one can see the content and its orientation degree in the image that the question asks about and can answer confidently ; (2) one can recognize camera viewpoint and camera shot of the image that the question asks about and can answer confidently ; The question can be multiple choice questions given the choice , or open - ended questions . For multiple choice , the option expression can be diverse but with the same meaning . For example , " front " also means " directly towards the camera "; ’ back ’ also means ’ away from the camera ’, etc . Use the common sense to make options diverse if possible . Provide at most 5 pairs of question and answer pairs . Prior the confident questions . Do not ask any question that cannot be answered confidently . You should ask questions from multiple QA templates as the below examples show . Example Input Description : The image shows a front view of police van . A blue and white police van with the word " POLICE " emblazoned on the side is parked on a city street . Nearby , a couple of officers are discussing a recent incident while pedestrians walk by , some glancing curiously at the vehicle . The police van is with an azimuth of 181.518 degree , facing Front direction . The elevation angle of the camera to the police van is 81.41 degree , the camera viewpoint is Horizontal view . The relative distance from the camera to the police van is 1.132 meters , the camera shot type is Close - up . Example Output Question and Answer Pairs : Question : From the camera ’ s perspective , is the police van in the picture facing straight or oriented at an angle ? Options : ( a ) Directly towards the camera ( b ) At an angle === Answer : ( a ) Directly towards the camera === Question : Is the police van in the picture facing the camera or away from the camera ? Options : ( a ) Away from the camera ( b ) Facing the camera === Answer : ( b ) Facing the camera === Question : Which direction is the police van facing in the image ? Options : (1) Back (2) Front === Answer : (2) Front === Question : Is the police van facing back or front from the camera ’ s perspective ? Options : ( a ) Back ( b ) Front === Answer : ( b ) Front === Question : Is the photo taken directly above the police van or from the side ? Options : ( a ) Taken directly ( b ) From the side === Answer : ( b ) From the side === Question : Is the photo taken far away the police van or taken closely ? === Answer : The relative distance from the camera to the police van is 1.132 meters , thus it is with a close - up shot . This indicates the photo is taken closely . === Question : What is the elevation viewpoint of the image ? Options : (1) Top (2) Horizontal (3) Bottom === Answer : (2) Horizontal === Question : Which camera shots is the image ? Options : (1) Close - up (2) Medium - shot (3) Long - shot === Answer : (1) Close - up "

blocks.en: 12  Factors influencing Image Generation
blocks.zh: 12 影响图像生成的因素

blocks.en: Several factors may lead to unreasonable artifacts in our image generation pipeline. In Fig. 8 , the upper-left example shows that bottom-view camera-object relations can introduce physical anomalies, such as the tricycle appearing with its front lifted unnaturally. The upper-right example highlights that low-quality 3D assets can produce fragmented depth maps or Canny edge visual priors, resulting in unrealistic generated images. The lower-left example shows that small subjects viewed from a long-shot perspective may lead to duplicate subjects in the generated image. The lower-right example illustrates how complex 3D asset structures can cause texture blending issues, particularly where intricate geometry is present.

blocks.en: There are several ways to reduce the influences from those factors. First, choosing 3D assets with reasonable number of meshes, and with plausible textures may filter the low-quality and texture blending failures. Second, using simple and compact image description prompts to generate long-shot camera-shot images will significantly reduce the duplicate subject failures. Reduce the image generation with high elevation angle from bottom view will significantly reduce physical anomaly.

blocks.en: 16  Generalization to Real Images: ImageNet3D
blocks.zh: 16 向真实图像概括:图像Net3D

blocks.en: To test whether the camera–object relation knowledge learned from our synthetic data transfers to real photographs, we evaluate on ImageNet3D Ma et al. (2024b) , a benchmark of ∼ {\sim} 69K ImageNet images with human-annotated 3D object poses across 189 categories, collected independently of our pipeline. We convert its validation split into our VQA format, keeping images that contain a single quality-checked annotated object (23,224 images, 186 categories). Annotated azimuth and elevation are discretized into our eight orientation and three viewpoint classes; we validated this mapping against PASCAL3D+ labels on the 1,109 images shared by both datasets (97.5% and 99.0% agreement, respectively). As ImageNet3D does not annotate camera shot, we derive shot labels from object framing (the maximum bounding-box extent relative to the image), calibrated to our three shot classes, with ambiguous boundary ranges excluded. Since real photographs are strongly biased toward frontal, eye-level views, we sample an answer-balanced evaluation set of 1,200 questions per task. ImageNet3D is used for evaluation only.
blocks.zh: 为了测试相机-对象关系知识是否从我们的合成数据传输到真实照片中得知,我们在ImageNet3D Ma et al.(2024b)上评价,这个基准为 ~ ~ {\sim} 69K图像网的图像 人类附加说明的3D对象 包含189个类别, 收集独立于我们的管道。 我们将其验证转换成我们的VQA格式,保留包含单一质量检查附加注释对象的图像(23,224张图像,186个类别)。 标注的方位角和高度被分为8个方向和3个视角类;我们用两个数据集共享的1,109张图像(分别为97.5%和99.0%)上的PASCAL3D+标签验证了这一绘图。 由于ImageNet3D没有标注相机镜头,我们从对象设定(相对于图像的最大边框范围)中得出镜头标签,校准到我们的三个镜头类,排除了模糊的边界范围. 由于真实的照片强烈偏向于正面的,眼层的视角,我们抽取了一组答案平衡的评价,每件任务有1200个问题. ImageNet3D只用于评价.

blocks.en: Table 4 compares each baseline with its Ultimate3D-fine-tuned counterpart. Fine-tuning improves every model on every task (+15.2, +7.8, and +7.8 points on average for orientation, viewpoint, and camera shot). The baselines largely collapse onto frequent answers (e.g., “Front” for most orientation questions), whereas the fine-tuned models spread predictions across all classes and gain most on rear and oblique views, indicating improved camera–object understanding rather than better answer priors. The one residual gap is the Long-shot class, whose accuracy decreases after fine-tuning; we attribute this to our synthetic long shots being clean, object-centered renders, unlike cluttered real-world wide shots, and leave closing this gap to future work.

blocks.en: 18  Additional Discussions
blocks.zh: 18 补充讨论

blocks.en: We provide some insights of using synthetic generated visual instruction dataset for MLLM finetuning. For the task of camera-object relation recognition for 100 categories (as we collected in Ultimate3D dataset), a dataset comprising 100K to 1M VQAs will significantly improve baseline MLLMs by one-epoch finetuning. Further scaling up the dataset volume, finetuneing epochs, or model parameters may yield saturation.
blocks.zh: 我们对使用合成生成的视觉指令数据集进行MLLM微调提供了一些见解. 对于100类的相机-对象关系识别任务(正如我们在Ultimate3D数据集中收集的那样),一个包含100K到1M VQA的数据集将会通过一个时代的微调来大大改进基线MLLMs. 进一步提升数据集体积,微调时代,或模型参数可能会产生饱和.

blocks.en: Moreover, the quality of synthetic dataset is crucial to the improvement margin. Using dataset with higher success rate (ours is 93.07% as main paper Sec. 4.6 ) provides better performances than using dataset generated other alternative backbones (i.e. SD-V1.5).
blocks.zh: 此外,合成数据集的质量对于改进幅度至关重要。 使用成功率较高的数据集(我们作为主纸Sec.4.6的成绩为93.07%)提供比使用生成的其他替代骨干数据集(即SD-V1.5)更好的性能.

blocks.en: The coverage of arbitrary camera-object relation is also important for generalization. Our preliminary test using real images which are highly biased to front-facing direction from Pascal3D+ Xiang et al. (2014) , results in poor generalization on uncovered orientations and viewpoints. This illustrates the importance of using synthetic dataset to eliminate the dataset biases.
blocks.zh: 对任意的相机-对象关系进行覆盖对于概括也十分重要. 我们利用Pascal3D+的 高度偏向前视方向的真实图像进行初步测试 Xiang等人(2014年)指出, 这说明使用合成数据集消除数据集偏差的重要性。

blocks.en: For numerical prediction of camera-object relation, our preliminary test shows plausible success using MEBOW Wu et al. (2020) dataset to improve MLLMs on predicting human orientation angles. The average degree prediction accuracy is competitive to the original paper Wu et al. (2020) . However, the extended numerical prediction of 100 categories and 3 types of camera-object relations may require even larger dataset volume than Ultimate3D . Our framework is able to scale up the dataset volume. But due to the limitation of computing power, we leave it as interesting future work.
blocks.zh: 关于相机-物体关系的数字预测,我们的初步测试显示,使用MEBOW Wu等人取得了令人信服的成功。 (2020)数据集用于改进预测人类方向角度的MLLMs. 平均学位预测精度与原论文"吴某等人"(2020年)有竞争力. 然而,对100类和3类相机-物体关系的扩展数字预测可能需要比Ultimate3D更大的数据集量。 我们的框架能够扩大数据集的数量。 但是由于计算力的限制,我们把它留作有趣的未来工作.
